notes: ACCESS: laredoute.co.uk returns a Cloudflare 'Country challenge' interstitial (HTTP 403) to every method tried: direct requests, a 13-profile curl_cffi sweep (chrome99-131, safari15-18/ios, edge99/101, firefox133/135), r.jina.ai (also 403 with a Cloudflare 'Just a moment' page), and translate.goog (same country-challenge wall). robots.txt (200) worked but sitemap.xml was blocked. WebFetch was the only route that got past the interstitial (renders past JS) and was used for every page in this extraction; browser automation was not used per Rule 2. All qty figures are the exact integer WebFetch read from the rendered category-page header/count (quoted in each row's evidence); several were re-verified with a second independently-worded WebFetch call on the same URL and returned identical numbers (Mirrors 321, Vases/Pots/Planters 435, Wall Lights 254, Table & Desk Lamps 343) -- no drift observed. Site confirmed live and not retired/redirected (Rule 3). SCOPE: this is indeed a large fashion/furniture-led multi-category UK storefront (French-owned) with only a modest genuine home-decor footprint, as the brief anticipated -- most of the top nav (Bedroom & Bedding, Sofas & Armchairs, Tables & Chairs, Furniture, Home Furnishings & Textiles -- confirmed 100% textile sub-nav, Rugs & Runners, Electricals & Cookware) is out of scope. EXTRACTED from 'Home Accessories & Décor', 'Lighting', and 'Kitchen & Dine' top-nav sections. HIERARCHY: 'Mirrors' (321, a roll-up superset that itself includes bathroom mirrors) has exactly one explicit child 'Bathroom Mirrors' (12) in the site's own nav tree -- emitted Mirrors as a parent grouping row per the brief's own worked example (Mirrors -> Bathroom Mirrors), not as a leaf, to avoid double counting/padding. RULE 0 GAIN: included Outdoor Lights (66) and Kids Lighting (41, bedroom-by-room lighting for children) and Bathroom Mirrors (12) -- all room-qualified nodes that a room-word-based exclusion would have dropped. EXCLUDED and why: Plant Shop 363 (confirmed artificial/faux plants, flowers, dried botanicals -- explicit exclusion); Candle Shop's 'Candles' node 127 (mixed scented/unscented wax + LED/printed candles with no separate unscented-only listing -- Home Fragrance rule; kept 'Candle Holders' 113 which is a clean separate decorative listing) and 'Diffusers' (home fragrance); Doorstops & Draught Excluders 5 (site's own copy frames them as functional/insulating, not decor); Storage Décor 546 and all 8 children (Baskets & Boxes, Storage Trunks & Chests, Umbrella Stands, Room Dividers & Screens, Coat Hooks & Racks, Kitchen Storage, Bathroom Storage, Toy Boxes -- all functional storage/furniture-adjacent); Kids' Accessories 9 (mostly storage trunks/baskets, only 3 of 9 titles were wall decorations -- too small/mixed to carve out); Wallpaper and Paint (explicit exclusions -- construction/DIY & wall-covering); Garden Decoration 237 (mixed roll-up of cushions, jute runners, a console table, planters and lanterns -- majority non-decor and appears to duplicate items already counted under Candles/Outdoor Lights, e.g. 'Luma LED Candle' recurs verbatim); Lighting Accessories 48 (confirmed bulbs, lamp cables, mounting hooks -- explicit exclusion); 'New In Lighting', 'New In Home Accessories', 'Christmas Lights & String Lights', 'Christmas Home', 'Pet shop' (marketing/holiday/non-decor nav, never-extract list); Cushions & Cushion Covers, Curtains/Blinds, Throws, Rugs & Runners, Table & Kitchen Linen (textiles); Cutlery, Pots & Pans, Baking & Kitchen Storage (flatware/cookware); Table Accessories 117 (sample titles were trivets, placemats, butter dishes, egg cups, salt & pepper mills -- functional dining tools, not on the approved tableware/decor list). Kept 'Photo Frames' (48) under Wall Decor & Mirrors as a genuine wall/tabletop decor product type (not explicitly named in the brief's include list but structurally grouped by the site alongside Canvases/Posters/Clocks/Wall Decorations under its decor-facing 'Wall Art' nav, not under furniture or storage) -- flagged here for merge-time review if the orchestrator disagrees.
